retrievalProfile.description: A studio portrait featuring a central figure with a snake, framed by bold geometric sans-serif typography in a corner-hugging L-shape.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered studio portrait of a woman wearing a black headwrap, holding a flute-like instrument with a large boa constrictor draped over her shoulders, set against a neutral grey-purple background with bold orange and outlined typography positioned at the top and right edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with a slight diagonal lean
Typography forms a right-angle frame around the top-right corner
Warm skin tones and orange text contrast against a cool, muted background
Snake texture provides organic complexity against smooth studio lighting
coreInvariants: Neutral studio backdrop with soft vignette
High-contrast orange and black color palette for accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, figure occupies the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the head of the instrument.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left text, down the instrument to the face, following the snake's curve down the body, ending at the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room on the left and right sides to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography against low-saturation background; mid-range values for the subject.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Mix of solid fills and thin outlines for different words

composition.relationshipToImage: Running parallel to the right border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family using weight and fill/outline contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and 70s aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with a black headwrap and a large snake draped over her shoulders, holding a wooden flute, against a solid muted purple-grey background. Use warm, soft studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold geometric sans-serif text in bright orange. Place one word horizontally at the top right, and another word vertically along the right edge, rotated 90 degrees clockwise.

verificationChecks: Is the vertical text rotated 90 degrees?
Is the background a flat, muted studio color?
Does the orange text pop against the background?

postGenerationChecks: Confirm typography is uppercase geometric sans-serif
Ensure the snake is draped organically around the figure
Check that the right-side text is rotated vertically
Verify the color palette is limited to orange, black, and muted tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Geometric Sans-Serif + L-Frame Typography + Muted Backdrop
